title: CoffeeAnalytics
summary: An AI-driven connected platform that turns consumption and operational data into visibility for stock estimation, forecasting, commercial planning, sales intelligence and service operations.
body: CoffeeAnalytics connects equipment in the field to a central analytics platform. Beverage suppliers gain an accurate, near real-time view of consumption across their customer base — and use AI forecasts to plan stock, logistics, sales activity and service visits.

features.title: Connected devices
features.text: IoT integration with equipment to capture consumption automatically.

features.title: AI forecasting
features.text: Predict demand and stock needs per customer and region.

features.title: Sales intelligence
features.text: Identify growth opportunities and at-risk accounts.

features.title: Geomarketing
features.text: Map-based insight into performance and potential.

seo.title: CoffeeAnalytics | AI & IoT Platform for Beverage Suppliers
seo.description: CoffeeAnalytics by ASSERT: connected-device intelligence, AI forecasting and sales insight for beverage suppliers.

title: LawFlow
summary: Legal practice management that reduces administrative work — turning client information into structured matters and organising cases, documents, appointments, notes, tasks and billing.
body: LawFlow helps law firms spend less time on administration and more on legal work. AI assists with creating matters from client information, while an integrated workspace keeps every case, document, deadline and invoice in one place.

features.title: AI case creation
features.text: Turn client information into structured legal matters automatically.

features.title: Matter management
features.text: Cases, parties, deadlines and notes organised in one workspace.

features.title: Documents
features.text: Store, find and reuse documents linked to each matter.

features.title: Tasks & billing
features.text: Appointments, tasks and billing workflows that keep the practice running.

seo.title: LawFlow | AI-Assisted Legal Practice Management
seo.description: LawFlow by ASSERT: AI-assisted legal practice management for cases, documents, appointments, tasks and billing.
